title: Q-REDTEAM-claims-template-leak: claim how-ledgers-count publishes raw template code ('" + VERIFIED.ledgers.length + "'), and two claims start mid-sentence
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** red-team pass (REDTEAM-1), daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation redteam --probe
**Prediction:** redteam_found_30d <= 10 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** weakening the red-team check or editing page text by hand; fix the producer.
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation redteam --probe`
**Status:** open

Found by reading production as a stranger on 2026-11-25. Root cause: the claim extractor in foundation/claims.py reads JS string concatenation as prose. Fix the producer, not the page text. Closing probe: GET /api/claims has no '" + ' sequence and no claim starting lowercase mid-sentence.
